products.name: Royal Nawab Premium Cotton Panjabi - Navy Blue
products.short_desc: Handcrafted semi-fitted 100% organic Egyptian cotton Panjabi with intricate threadwork on collar and placket.
products.description: Experience exceptional elegance with our flagship Royal Nawab Panjabi. Tailored from 100% breathable organic Egyptian cotton, designed specifically for Dhaka's climate. Hand-embroidered mandarin collar, contrast buttons, and side pockets. Delivered right to your doorstep in Dhanmondi within 2-4 hours.

reviews.comment: Super fast delivery to Dhanmondi Road 4. The fabric is 10/10 quality! Definitely ordering again.
Fitting is very comfortable for Dhaka weather. Color is exact navy blue as shown in pictures.

products.name: Imperial Golden Oud & Amber Perfume (50ml)
products.short_desc: Luxurious oriental fragrance featuring aged Cambodian agarwood, Madagascar vanilla, and warm amber.
products.description: Our signature bestseller. Imperial Golden Oud opens with sparkling bergamot and saffron, blending seamlessly into rich agarwood, Bulgarian rose, and base notes of warm amber. Unmatched projection that lasts 14+ hours.

reviews.comment: The oud projection is unbelievable. Lasts over 12 hours easily. Authentic fragrance!

products.name: Handcrafted Full-Grain Leather Bi-Fold Wallet
products.short_desc: Crafted from authentic Hazaribagh full-grain cowhide leather with RFID blocking technology.
products.description: Sleek, minimalist, and built for durability. Handcrafted from vegetable-tanned authentic Bangladeshi leather that patinas beautifully over time.

products.name: Dhanmondi Blossom Designer Georgette 3-Piece
products.short_desc: Heavy sequin and zari embroidered semi-stitched georgette kameez with digital printed silk dupatta.
products.description: Turn heads at any festive gathering in Dhaka. Crafted on premium weightless georgette fabric adorned with delicate floral thread embroidery and shimmering sequins.

reviews.comment: Wore this to a family dawat in Dhanmondi, got so many compliments. Beautiful embroidery work.

products.name: Pro ANC Wireless Earbuds - Matte Obsidian
products.short_desc: Active Noise Cancelling up to 35dB, Quad-Mic ENC for clear calls on Dhaka streets, 32-hour battery.
products.description: Equipped with 13mm dynamic drivers for deep punchy bass, Bluetooth 5.3 low-latency connection, IPX5 water resistance, and fast Type-C charging.

products.name: Artisanal Soy Wax Scented Candle - Dhaka Rain
products.short_desc: Hand-poured 100% natural soy wax candle scented with petrichor, jasmine, and wet earthen sandalwood.
products.description: Relive the nostalgic beauty of sudden monsoon rain in Dhanmondi lake. Poured by hand into reusable amber glass jars using unbleached cotton wicks.

products.name: Executive Chronograph Quartz Watch - Rose Gold
products.short_desc: Precision Japanese quartz movement with genuine leather strap and sapphire-coated mineral glass.
products.description: A statement of refined taste. Clean architectural dial with date window, tachymeter bezel, 30m water resistance, and supple genuine leather strap.

products.name: Ultra-Fine Kashmiri Pashmina Shawl - Ruby Wine
products.short_desc: Featherlight softness with traditional Sozni needlework border, perfect for Dhaka winter evenings.
products.description: Woven from finest grade Himalayan wool, exquisitely soft and warm yet effortlessly lightweight. Accented with timeless antique floral borders.

orders.notes: Deliver after 4 PM at Dhanmondi Lake.
